title: E0101: Object Injection via unserialize
plain_english: Passing untrusted data to `unserialize()` can instantiate arbitrary PHP objects and trigger magic methods, leading to object injection and potentially remote code execution.
why_matters: PHP object injection is a critical vulnerability. Attackers can craft serialized objects that: - Trigger `__wakeup()`, `__destruct()`, or other magic methods - Execute arbitrary code through gadget chains - Read, modify, or delete files - Achieve full server compromise
what_it_checks: `unserialize()` calls where the argument may originate from `$_GET`, `$_POST`, `$_REQUEST`, `$_COOKIE`, or `php://input`
